summary: Franco-Nevada Corporation filed a Form 6-K furnishing its Q3 2026 results via news release, MD&A, interim financial statements and CEO/CFO certifications. Revenue was $549.3 million (+13% YoY) on 130,435 GEOs sold (-6%), with operating cash flow of $429.2 million, net income of $395.5 million ($2.05/share) and Adjusted EBITDA of $493.9 million. The company reports $4.8 billion in available capital and no debt, and notes a second tranche of financing for the Bullabulling deposit. This is a routine quarterly earnings filing, not a special situation; no transaction terms are stated.
